title: RNA sequencing in hBMSCs with DEPTOR knockdown
description: As an endogenous inhibitor, DEPTOR played an important role in cellular activities, while its role and effect in osteogenic differentiation remains unclear. To investigate the underlying mechanisms of DEPTOR, we conducted a RNA sequence to determine the expression profiles with DEPTOR knockdown in hBMSCs.
